# Jason DeBerardinis

> Co-founder of GRRO (AI search optimization) and SHEATH (premium knife rolls for chefs). Growing tech companies at Riviera Partners. Based in Massachusetts.

Jason DeBerardinis is a co-founder, operator, and builder focused on the next generation of distribution: how brands get discovered, recommended, and cited by AI systems like ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews.

## Currently Building

- [GRRO](https://grro.io): AI search optimization platform that helps brands get recommended by ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews.
- [SHEATH](https://sheathmade.com): Premium leather knife rolls handmade for professional chefs.
